candidates.statement: Order service returns 502 to gateway checkout; traces show order's downstream payment call failing with 503, propagating as 502 on /v1/orders and /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Root failure inside payment (503) is not directly observed; only order's client-side error is captured. Payment-side logs/metrics excluded.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s correlate with order returning 502 after payment returns 503 in traces; metrics show /v1/checkout 502 rate. Bounded candidate is downstream failure surfaced as 5xx, but payment-side root cause unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics to confirm the 503 origin and cause
Order service logs to confirm error handling path
Excluded gw_logs evidence to corroborate gateway-side errors
